_comment: Colour per purpose group. The comp assigned one vibrant oklch hue per category at matched lightness and chroma, so they sit together on the cream ground; those values are carried over here, re-keyed from the comp's invented ids to the dataset's real ones. Terracotta (--color-accent) is deliberately absent: it is reserved for the state-devolution row. Administrative tones are generated in build-data.mjs instead, because 56 ministries is too many to hand-author and the same matched-L/C rule produces them.
